name: mods-starter
description: Five small, commented Claude Code mods to copy and change: a status band, a pane with buttons, a command guard, a /plain-recap command, and a polling dashboard

plugins.name: status-band
plugins.description: A line above the prompt that says, in plain English, what Claude is doing right now and for how long

plugins.name: panel-with-buttons
plugins.description: A /edits command that opens a pane listing the files Claude changed this session, with Clear and Close buttons

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Pauses risky shell commands (rm -rf, force push, DROP TABLE) and asks you Proceed or Cancel first

plugins.name: slash-command
plugins.description: A /plain-recap command that summarizes the session so far in plain English for a non-engineer

plugins.name: dashboard
plugins.description: A /dashboard pane that fetches a JSON URL every minute and shows a few numbers from it
